description: PII / secret redaction wrapper. Wraps compute with a log proxy that scrubs matching keys from `context.log.info/warning/error` calls + `MaterializeResult.metadata` dicts before persistence. Each run emits AssetObservation(sensitive_redacted_count=N) so audits can prove the scrub ran. Case-insensitive glob patterns (`*`, `?`) on dict keys and inline `key=value` string fragments. Redaction strategies: `redact` (→ [REDACTED]), `hash` (→ sha256:xxxxxxxx), `mask` (→ ***last4). Defaults cover common PII/secret field names. Companion @sensitive decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Materialization metadata is redacted; AssetObservation carries the redaction count.

keys.label: Redacted Keys
keys.description: Case-insensitive globs. Defaults to a common PII/secrets list.

name: Sensitive Asset
